caption:
weekday lunch diaries
chole masala | dahi | kachumber | fresh phulka

I’ve never made chole masala before, one because my mother always aced Sunday lunches with it and two, because I’ve never craved it like I did last week! 
Some foods remind you of home in the most obvious ways and some give you a tinker in your soul with a craving that can’t be fulfilled unless you make it yourself 
do you want the chole recipe? I think I did a great job and it was definitely no fuss! let me know in the comments :) I also calculated calories if that interests you ;)

Also I feel the need to add kachumber to every lunch now because it’s so fresh and zingy it’s absolute perfection 💕

No classic puri because #health and I demolished a bhatura last week when I was out 🤣

And Dahi, because obviously Dahi completes this meal like no other pairing you can imagine 😍
